comments.author: gogochlwns
comments.body_html:
Items will basically go into bag first when looting.

However, magazines, grenades, and ammunition are supposed to go into the vest first.

Do this mod override this? Will the items be put in the container with high priority unconditionally?

comments.author: CactusPie
comments.body_html:
Yup, this mod ignores the item category entirely. Bags will be filled in the order you specify regardless of the type of the item you’re transferring.

Later I will release a version that will also allow to reverse the direction in which the cells inside the bags are filled - so for instance backpack will be filled from the bottom instead of from the top. This will be optional though
